instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Structure pages with clean white and sky-blue sections, using dark navy (#0B1D3A) for bold headings with sky-blue (#0284C7) highlighted spans as seen in the reference screenshot.
2. Implement the floating glass Trust Bar in the hero containing 'Global Network', '24/7 Support', 'Safe & Reliable' with real Indian port authority compliance metrics.
3. Build the 'Our 30+ Specialized Services' interactive directory with category filters, numbered circles (01, 02, 03...), search bar, and 1-click WhatsApp quote links.
4. Feature Hold Cleaning & Tank Squeezing with an interactive before/after interactive comparison viewer, checklist pills, and high-pressure cleaning specifications.
5. Ensure the top Navigation bar features the slide-in right drawer panel on mobile/hamburger, quick phone pill button on desktop (+91 9712476193), and seamless route links.

6. Provide both a Customer Portal (quotation management, IMO vessel profile, PDF download) and an Admin Operations Console (manage incoming enquiries, update status, generate quotation line items with GST).
7. Include permanent floating action buttons for WhatsApp (+91 9712476193 with pre-filled vessel inquiry text) and Direct Email (supply@iconicshipping.org).
8. Apply data-testid attributes to all CTA buttons, tabs, enquiry forms, and filters.
